key_provisions_or_claims: ETSI published a technical specification on baseline cyber security requirements for AI models and systems, plus an implementation technical report.
Described as the first global standard setting minimum security requirements across the whole AI life cycle.
Defines 13 core security principles grouped into 5 life cycle stages.
UK will update its AI Cyber Security Code of Practice and Implementation Guide to mirror the ETSI documents.
Next step is to progress toward a European standard with other standards bodies.
named_instruments_referenced: UK AI Cyber Security Code of Practice
NCSC Guidelines for Secure AI System Development
ETSI TS 104 223 Baseline Cyber Security Requirements for AI
annotation.summary_en: NCSC blog post announcing ETSI's publication of a technical specification and report on baseline cyber security requirements for AI models and systems, developed with DSIT and industry. It presents 13 principles across five life cycle stages and says the UK Code of Practice will be aligned to it.
annotation.title_clean: New ETSI standard protects AI systems from evolving cyber security threats
